primary: trim10, four weak conditions equally weighted A1-A0 utilization
support: >=0.15 mean utilization gain AND >=2/3 positive pairs in each weak condition
normal_guard: Each normal condition mean utilization >=A0-.03 AND mean queue<=1.2*A0+1ms
other_metrics: Report full/trim10 mean/P95/P99/drop/CPU; guard failure rejects success. A4 is diagnostic only.
cpu_protocol: One TCP run per host. All four arms of a condition/repeat block on same host. CPU comparisons within paired host blocks only. No scans during frozen runs.
design_change: Five available matching hosts permit disjoint blocks in parallel, rather than one-host serial72. Not independent training seeds.
history_reset: Zero63+current7 before first released query; max_bw zeroed before boundary normalization forA2.
followup: No automaticA3, repeated grey-zone evaluations, training, or budget extension
